subject.title: [Feature]: Support Excel (.xlsx/.xls) and generic binary uploads in gateway / input_file

question: Should OpenClaw add a core Gateway/OpenResponses binary `input_file` receipt contract for Excel and allowlisted binaries, or narrow this issue to Excel while routing generic/provider-native file behavior elsewhere?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the remaining work defines public upload, storage, redaction, retention, and tool-access semantics rather than a narrow code repair.

options.title: Approve Core Binary Receipts
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical Gateway workspace/persistence contract and require explicit MIME, size, URL, redaction, metadata, retention, and tool-access rules before implementation.

options.title: Narrow To Excel Receipts
options.body: Limit this issue to allowlisted Excel persistence and leave generic binary/provider-native forwarding to broader file-input work.

options.title: Defer To Plugin/API Design
options.body: Leave core behavior unchanged until a plugin or ClawHub package proves the workflow and exposes any missing extension API needs.

recommendation.title: Approve Core Binary Receipts
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical Gateway workspace/persistence contract and require explicit MIME, size, URL, redaction, metadata, retention, and tool-access rules before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined Gateway/OpenResponses history and product-direction signal for the public upload contract.
